description: Header file defining the DnsConfigServiceWin class for Windows DNS configuration management, including functions for parsing domain names, search lists, and converting settings to DNS configurations. It declares internal classes for watching and reading DNS settings.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin
classes.description: Service class for reading and watching Windows DNS system settings, not thread-safe, performs blocking I/O, used for configuring DNS settings.

classes.name: Watcher
classes.description: Internal class for watching DNS configuration changes.

classes.name: ConfigReader
classes.description: Internal class for reading DNS configuration.

classes.name: HostsReader
classes.description: Internal class for reading host entries.

methods.name: StartWatching
methods.description: Starts watching for DNS configuration changes.
